title: Haye Imam E Raza as
body:
Haye Imam-E-Raza (AS)
<<DIVIDER>>
Haye Imam-E-Raza (AS), Haye Imam-E-Raza
Chahne Waale Sabhi Karte Hain Girya
<<DIVIDER>>
Khoo'n Hai Zameen Par Pada Dekhti Hoon Main Jidhar
Neela Badan Ho Gaya, Zehr Ka Hai Woh Asar
Din Meri Taqdeer Ne Kaisa Dikhaya Mujhe
Phir Mere Ek Laal Ka Girta Hai Kat Ke Jigar
Thaame Hue Pasliyan Kehti Hain Zahra
<<DIVIDER>>
Sadma Hai Itna Bada Hoti Hai Dil Mein Chubhan
Barhte Hi Jaayenge Ab Roz Yeh Ranj-O-Mahan
Chahne Waale Sabhi Ashk Bahaane Lage
Jaane Lage Chhod Kar Jad Ki Tarah Jab Watan
Kehta Tha Mat Jaaiye Saara Madina
<<DIVIDER>>
Hota Hai Pardes Mein Sab Se Bichhadne Ka Gham
Dil Mein Thin Bechainiyan, Saath The Ranj-O-Alam
Zehr Woh Angoor Mein De Diya Mamoon Ne
Dard Se Ugla Lahu, Toda Ghareebi Mein Dam
Zulm Musaafir Pe Yeh Ho Gaya Kaisa
<<DIVIDER>>
Chehra-E-Ghamnaak Ko Ashkon Se Dhote Hue
Jaan Gham-E-Hijr Mein Karb Se Khote Hue
Bhai Ke Marne Ki Jab Paayi Safar Mein Khabar
Khwahar-E-Mola Raza Gir Gayin Rote Hue
Sah Na Paayi Behan Bhai Ka Sadma
<<DIVIDER>>
Chaaron Taraf Toos Mein Abr-E-Alam Chha Gaye
Aise Masaayeb Bhi The Dil Ko Jo Tadpa Gaye
Zehr Ki Shiddat Se Jab Badhne Lagi Tashnagi
Roye Bahut Cheekh Kar Yaad Hasan (AS) Aa Gaye
Bhool Na Paaye Kabhi Jad Ka Tadapna
<<DIVIDER>>
Din Yeh Qayamat Ka Hai, Sog Bapa Ho Gaya
Khaana-E-Sadaat Mein Bichh Gaya Farsh-E-Aza
Shaamil Karb-E-Raza Hum Hi Akele Nahin
Aaj Shareek-E-Aza Honge Sabhi Ambiya
Khaak Udaayenge Sab Padh Ke Yeh Nauha
<<DIVIDER>>
Mir Hilal Aaj Hain Gham Mein Imam-E-Zaman
Zikr-E-Ghareeb-Ul-Watan Karte Hain Peer-O-Jawaan
Zehr-E-Dagha Se Hua Dilbar-E-Kazim Shaheed
Doob Gaya Aeliya Sog Mein Saara Jahaan
Keh Ke Yeh Taboot Ko Dijiye Kandha
author: Mir Hilal Rizvi
